calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark asset, negate its five-session cumulative return and scale by its trailing 20-session realized volatility. The one-session lag ensures only completed data are used at the decision time. Higher values indicate stronger expected 10-session reversal returns.

admission_gates.note: The reported IC/ICIR use the 10-session forward-return horizon used for admission in this benchmark.

validation.regime_notes: Full-history relationship is positive and strongest at 10-20 sessions; recent 250-date IC is near the threshold but ICIR remains positive, while recent 500-date performance is strong. Interpret conservatively in the small 15-asset universe.
validation.provenance: Computed from persistent/stock_data close series through 2029-12-26; cross-sectional Spearman IC requires at least 8 valid assets per date and used all 15 available assets.
